newsResults.title: Singapore Airlines' investment record in other airlines
newsResults.summary: Singapore Airlines, which holds a 25.1% stake in Air India, is being asked to inject an additional $1.5 billion in equity alongside Tata Sons. The move comes as Singapore’s transport minister urges the carrier to expand its overseas footprint.

newsResults.title: Crocodile rescued, safely released at Tamil Nadu’s Kallanai
newsResults.summary: On September 7, 2026, a joint team of the Tamil Nadu Forest Department and Fire and Rescue Services rescued a stray crocodile from the Rettamalai area near Tiruchirappalli and released it at Kallanai. The operation was completed safely by midday, averting potential danger to local laborers.

newsResults.title: Satya Niketan collapse: CM Rekha Gupta announces Rs 5 lakh aid, orders immediate demolition of unsafe adjoining building
newsResults.summary: Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta visited AIIMS to meet victims of the Satya Niketan building collapse, pledging Rs 5 lakh assistance to affected families and ordering the demolition of a nearby unsafe structure. The tragedy claimed seven lives and left twelve injured, prompting police action and municipal safety measures.
